free_tier.value: 2,500 requests per day (UTC day, resets at 24:00 UTC); free trial tier; free while testing; no credit card required; testing only; rate limit 1 request/second on free trial

price_beyond_free.value: From $50/mo (USD, VAT inclusive): X-Small $50/mo (~$0.17 per 1,000), Small $125/mo (~$0.14 per 1,000), Medium $500/mo (~$0.13 per 1,000), Large $1000/mo (~$0.11 per 1,000), Enterprise from $2000/mo

rate_limit.value: 1 request per second (free trial hard limit); 15 req/s X-Small, 20 req/s Small, 25 req/s Medium, 40 req/s Large on paid subscriptions

storage_permitted.value: "Feel free to cache, or store, results as long as you like, you know your use case and whether or not it makes sense. This applies whether you are on our free-trial, or you have become a paying customer, and even after you stop being a customer. Unlike many geocoding services we do not have different pricing tiers for "temporary" and "permanent" data storage. All data returns by the API can be stored permanently."

attribution_required.value: No visible attribution to OpenCage required ("There is no need to attribute us, it's not our data."). Only OpenStreetMap attribution is required: "On your about page or similar page where it can easily be found add `\"Geodata copyright OpenStreetMap contributors\"`."

storage_permitted.value: From the HERE Platform Terms (Sept 18 2023), Section 6.4(j): "Cache or store outside of the Platform any Results that include anything from the use of HERE Content or Location Services for more than 30 days, except HERE Positioning services which cannot be cached or stored outside the Platform for more than 24 hours, unless Results are used solely for your internal testing, evaluation, or record retention for audit and legal compliance purposes"; Section 6.4(k): "Cache or store any Results from HERE Content and Location Services for Japan (with the exception of Geocoding and Search as described in context of these services) for more than 24 hours, unless Results are generated using an Asset Subscription Plan or a Monthly Active User (MAU) HERE Navigate SDK Subscription Plan and are stored on a smartphone (or tablet that is diverting smartphone services), in which case Results can be cached or stored for a maximum of 30 days"; Exhibit 2 Section 1.3: "In addition to the caching restrictions in the Platform Terms, you may not use HERE Materials in a manner that pre-fetches, caches, or stores data or Results, except as explicitly allowed by the caching headers (HTTP/1.1 standard) returned by HERE Location Services."

attribution_required.value: Yes. From HERE Platform Terms Section 13.1: "You may not remove or obfuscate any HERE Marks or copyright notices affixed to or included in HERE Materials or Results. You will ensure that all HERE Marks and copyright notices are present in the HERE Materials and Result in accordance with HERE brand guidance (https://brandlive.here.com/). You must indicate that HERE is the owner of HERE Marks. All goodwill from the use of HERE Marks inures to HERE." Additional restriction in Section 6.4(m): you may not "Use incorrect attribution of any information derived from the Platform." Per developer terms-and-conditions: "In all instances where HERE Materials are used or where your marketing materials reference HERE Materials (collectively 'Collateral') you must attribute HERE as the creator and source of origin of the HERE Materials and you shall not in any way imply that you or any third party is the creator or source of origin."
